answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a bonded identity reef: before an agent may attest, it must lock a slashable stake into the shared vault, and each attestation must carry a freshly mined proof-of-work stamp. Launching N fake identities therefore costs N stakes plus N independent work-units, so forging a quorum is N times more expensive than honest participation, and slashed stake is burned rather than refunded. A sonnet of identical clones gains nothing, because attestation weight counts paid bonds, never voices.
